review_route.rationale: Supported-host active-path linearization and deterministic enumeration limits are repeatedly falsified security and correctness boundaries.

material_finding.summary: The enumeration loop propagates EntrySource/readdir errors through entries.next()? before incrementing the per-scan count, adding name bytes, or charging the cumulative EnumerationBudget. At an exhausted cumulative boundary, a subsequent error therefore returns ReadFailed instead of the required counted ResourceLimit.
material_finding.contract_impact: The candidate terminates and does not expose content, but it fails the adopted deterministic resource semantics and the explicit requirement that every non-EOF source observation, including errors, is accounted before outcome classification.

required_correction: charge every non-EOF source observation, including errors, before propagating its outcome
preserve partial-observation discard and guaranteed directory-stream close behavior
add exact per-scan and cumulative boundary-error controls
rerun the exact 53-test repository-fit boundary and independently recheck the corrected set

supported_host_linearization.result: RENAME_SWAP produced active foreign bytes; the probe returned StaleBinding and exited zero
supported_host_linearization.ceiling: Sequential final completed observation only; no function-return-state or permanent namespace guarantee.

highest_defensible_ceiling: The supported-host active-path race correction and prior finite budgets are supported, but repository-fit acceptance remains withheld until source errors are budget-accounted and the exact corrected set is independently verified.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim public integration, repository-fit completion, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
